sensitivity_sobol.implementation: genuine scipy.stats.qmc.Sobol(d=10, scramble=True, seed=970021).random_base2 — one 2D design split into A(cols0-4)/B(cols5-9); A_B(i) hybrids. First-order = Saltelli 2010 covariance mean(B*(AB-A))/var; total = Jansen 1999 mean((A-AB)^2)/(2*var). No clipping of negatives (L228 'retained without clipping'; the abs()/max(0) hits are convergence-change magnitudes and quantile clamps).

gates_calibration.summary: Independent re-audit of Phase 9.7 leakage, effect-validation, downstream, uncertainty-coverage and FYM-calibration gates. All five audited defects are properly closed. The leakage gate is computed from effect_only_dataset.csv (all 5 checks recomputed: 56 locations, 31 train / 25 excluded, 0 crossovers, matching the committed evidence) and fails closed under four injected leakage scenarios plus missing-column and empty inputs, naming the crossover each time. The independent effect-validation gate is a genuine evidence contract: it fails closed on absent/malformed metadata, is correctly False now (no dataset), and passes only with valid synthetic evidence covering all 7 target/horizon pairs -- not forced-false. Downstream eligibility is a real 5-way conjunction reading separately-computed evidence (not the legacy hardcoded literals still present in prediction.gates); recomputation matches the committed result, and forcing the inputs True flips eligibility to True. Three gates block (effect_prediction, ood_performance, independent validation); leakage and uncertainty pass; selection/regret correctly not executed. All 14 coverage cells reproduce exactly (0 arithmetic mismatches) and every target passes; the rule is structurally sound and far better than the Phase 9.6 0.80-1.00 band, but it is PERMISSIVE at n=24 (ood band [0.75,1.00], upper acceptance=100% so overcoverage cannot fail) -- a disclosed limitation, not a defect. FYM calibration is boundary-constrained at 1.10 (upper bound), edge slope -7.865 (fit still improving beyond bound), non-identifiable ([1.10,1.10]), held-out cessation RMSE 7.577/MAE 7.214/bias -7.214; RothC constants and the [0.90,1.10] bound are unchanged and the documentation does not overstate success. No discrepancies between reported and independently recomputed values.
